title: Settings and keymap
kicker: Session and shell · how you play
hook: **System** is where you rebind keys, adjust display, and quit — open it with Esc when no layer is stacked on top.

blindSpots.meaning: The settings layer for Rise of Summoner’s control room — not the lawn game’s own options menu.
No Creatures/Fusion/… layer is open. Only then does Esc open System instead of closing a layer.
Which keys open which rail verbs. It should match what the [layer rail](layer-rail) does.
Leaves the control-room session from System. On some browser-only paths Quit may be unavailable — close the tab or use the launcher.

alsoTrue: From the title screen, Settings jumps into System over Sanctum — same surface.
Developer telemetry and cheat menus are not this page and are not player features.

sections.title: How you open it
steps: Close any open layers until you are back on the bare stage.
Or choose Settings on the title screen.
sections.note: If Esc only closes a panel, you still had a layer open — that is correct stack behavior.

cards.name: Keybinds
cards.body: Rebind rail and travel keys. Pressing ? should agree with the rail.

cards.name: Display
cards.body: How the control room looks on your machine.

cards.name: Quit
cards.body: Leave the session cleanly when the build supports it.

sections.title: What stays elsewhere
paras: Lawn-game graphics, volume, and packs options stay in the host game.
Installer trust and antivirus steps stay in the launcher / player runbook — not inside System.

doSteps: From Sanctum, press Esc with nothing else open.
Find the keymap and confirm it matches C / F / E / … on the rail.
Close System and confirm you return to the same stage.
doNote: Stop when Esc feels predictable. Rail detail: [layer rail](layer-rail).

mixUps.q: Esc closed Creatures instead of Settings — bug?
mixUps.a: No. Esc closes the top layer first. Open System only on an empty stack.
In Plants vs. Zombies: Fusion itself. System is the RPG control room.
Same System surface — different doors in.

mixUps.q: Can I rebind lawn plant keys here?
mixUps.a: No. This keymap is for Rise of Summoner layers and travel.
